## About
Body Work by Fischer has been family owned and operated by the Starr family for decades. The business was passed from Dave Sr. to Dave Jr., and we're here to walk every customer through their repair step by step.
We're an ASE certified, full-service body shop. Our specialty is collision repair, and we also handle frame straightening, refinishing and color matching. We try to be fair and fix damage rather than replace parts to save you money.
Customers rate us 4.9 from 73 Google reviews. Our goal has always been to build a strong clientele and be an asset to the community.

## Services
- Collision Work: All collision repairs from start to finish. We look over the damage and give you an estimate of the repair cost before any work begins.
- Auto Body Repair & Refinishing: When we repair a door or other broken part, we refinish it so no one can tell you had an accident. We also provide on-site mechanical repairs when necessary.
- Expert Frame Straightening: Using our Kar Grabber frame machine, we straighten a damaged frame back to its factory specifications.
- Expert Color Matching: We use BASF paint, a computerized color matcher and high-quality clear coats to color and panel match everything on your vehicle. Our technicians know their way around pearl whites.

## FAQ
Q: Can I choose my own body shop?
A: Yes. Your body shop is your choice, and you're welcome to bring your car to us.

Q: Do you work on imports as well as domestic cars?
A: Yes. We're a full-service body shop for both domestic and import models.

Q: Will I know how the repair is going?
A: Yes. We keep you informed as the repairs move along, and we aim to finish in the time frame we set at the start.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Give us a call at (908) 232-5305 or email info@bodyworkbyfischernj.com, and we'll set you up with an estimate on your bodywork.
